name: Valtteri Kärkinen
bio:
Valtteri's motorsport journey began, predictably perhaps, with a childhood karting obsession fueled by watching the exploits of Finnish Formula 1 legends. While his own racing aspirations never materialized beyond the local karting club, his passion for the sport never waned. After earning a degree in communications, he started his career in a small marketing agency before landing a role with a regional rally team. He quickly discovered a knack for crafting compelling narratives and managing media relations.

Valtteri believes in a proactive and transparent approach to PR. He focuses on building strong relationships with journalists, understanding their needs, and providing them with accurate and timely information. He's particularly skilled at navigating crisis situations and maintaining a positive public image for his clients. His experience working with smaller teams has instilled in him a resourceful and adaptable mindset, making him a valuable asset in any environment. He is known for his loyalty and dedication to his colleagues, but also for his unwavering commitment to the truth, even when it is uncomfortable.

physical.description: Valtteri is of average height with a sturdy build, often sporting a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of chewing on pens when stressed.
Insists on using Finnish idioms in team meetings, even when no one understands them.
